# Epic EHR Go-Live — Phase 1

- **Goal / definition of done:** replace the legacy inpatient and ED systems with Epic at
  Riverbend General (flagship) and stabilize operations post-go-live.
- **Owner:** [Wei Chen](../people/wei-chen.md), Epic Program Director. Clinical sponsor:
  [Priya Anand](../people/priya-anand.md). Executive sponsor: Diane.
- **Status (current):** **Live since 2026-06-28; in stabilization.** The command center is
  active with declining ticket volume; **demobilization is targeted for ~2026-08-01.** Go-live
  itself is done — this is no longer a pre-launch project.
- **Scope note:** Phase 1 = flagship inpatient + ED only. Ambulatory/clinic sites and the other
  three hospitals are **later phases**, not part of Phase 1.

## Where it stands
- ED throughput dipped temporarily during go-live (expected) and is recovering.
- Highest open risk: analyst-team burnout and the uncovered lab-liaison role after
  [Gregory Pham](../people/gregory-pham.md) left.

## Not to be confused with
- [Epic Optimization — Phase 2](epic-optimization-phase-2.md) — a **separate, later** project
  for tuning and new modules (including bed management). Phase 1 is the initial go-live.
